reason: A offers the more physically plausible and directly testable strategy: a high-entropy fluorite support can provide diverse anchoring sites and oxygen-storage/redox behavior that may stabilize low-loading isolated PGMs during lean high-temperature operation. B confounds Pt-trimer addition with support modification, lacks cited support, and relies on Pt trimers remaining atomically defined under severe thermal cycling, an especially uncertain premise; however, A still needs better-matched evidence and a comparison against equal-performance, higher-PGM commercial baselines.
